zh-CN.intro: 0.1.2 重点改善独立审查、桌面工具布局和消息可靠性。主任务更安静，飞书与 Telegram 的回复更稳，插件面板和更新提示也更符合实际状态。移动端同步内容更新，无需重新安装。

topics.title: 独立检查当前成果
topics.text: 在桌面端输入 `/review`，可以让一个独立的只读任务检查当前成果，不会改动文件，也不会沿用开发任务中的记忆。文件或暂存内容发生变化后，旧结论会明确失效；工作区外的材料必须由你逐项确认。

topics.title: 工具入口更清爽
topics.text: 右侧工具栏集中保留文件、审查、Subagent、后台任务、浏览器和终端。资源用量移到左上角菜单并在独立窗口中打开，分屏时也能通过统一入口打开当前任务的工具面板。

topics.title: Mira 主题成为新用户默认
topics.text: 新用户首次打开应用时会直接使用暖灰与陶土色的 Mira 主题。原来的主题保留并改名为 Normal，已有用户保存的选择不会被覆盖。

topics.title: 主任务更安静
topics.text: Subagent 内部的思考和工具过程不再整段铺进主任务，最终结果、生成文件和媒体仍会正常显示。来自手机、即时通讯或自动化的消息也不会突然把当前阅读位置拉到底部，并会正确计入未读消息。

topics.title: 飞书群聊与 Telegram 回复更可靠
topics.text: 飞书机器人现在可以在群聊和话题中响应已绑定本人的 @，并把回复送回原来的群聊或话题；需要确认的操作会转到私聊。个人 Telegram bot 会把最终答案作为新消息发送，重试时从中断处继续，减少答案丢失或重复。

topics.title: 关闭插件面板不再停用插件
topics.text: 关闭停靠面板或独立插件窗口现在只会收起面板，不会停用插件；之后可以从插件页点“使用”重新打开。授权失效会显示明确状态，插件更新若需要重新连接账号，也会提前说明。

topics.title: 遇到问题时给出下一步
topics.text: 自动审批暂时无法判断时，需要确认的操作会交给你决定，不再直接失败。自动起名也会区分“还没有可命名的消息”和“当前供应商不支持”，减少只有笼统失败提示的情况。

topics.title: 更新状态说得更准确
topics.text: 更新包下载完成后，侧栏会明确显示“版本号已下载”，不再提前说成已经更新。更新说明和“重启更新”入口更加紧凑，重启前仍会检查正在运行的任务。

en.intro: Mira 0.1.2 improves independent review, desktop tool organization, and message reliability. Main tasks stay easier to follow, Feishu and Telegram replies are more dependable, and plugin panels and update prompts now behave more predictably. The mobile changes arrive as a content update with no reinstall required.

topics.title: Independent review of current work
topics.text: Run `/review` on desktop to check the current result in a separate read-only task that cannot modify files or reuse development memory. Existing conclusions are invalidated when the files or staged changes move on, and external items require explicit confirmation.

topics.title: Cleaner tool access
topics.text: The right-side toolbar now focuses on files, review, Subagents, background tasks, the browser, and the terminal. Resource Usage opens in its own window from the top-left menu, while split views use the same panel control as regular tasks.

topics.title: Mira is now the default theme for new users
topics.text: New users now start with Mira’s warm gray and terracotta theme. The previous theme remains available as Normal, and existing theme choices are preserved.

topics.title: A quieter main task
topics.text: Internal Subagent reasoning and tool chatter no longer flood the main task, while results, generated files, and media remain visible. Messages arriving from mobile, messaging channels, or automations no longer pull you away from what you are reading and are counted as unread when appropriate.

topics.title: More reliable Feishu and Telegram replies
topics.text: The Feishu bot can now respond when the linked owner mentions it in groups and topics, with replies returning to the correct place and confirmations moving to direct messages. The personal Telegram bot sends the final answer as a fresh message and resumes retries from the interruption point to reduce missing or duplicated replies.

topics.title: Closing a plugin panel no longer disables it
topics.text: Closing a docked panel or separate plugin window now hides the panel without disabling the plugin, and the Use button can open it again. Expired authorization is shown clearly, and updates warn you in advance when connected accounts will need to reconnect.

topics.title: Clear next steps when something fails
topics.text: When automatic approval cannot reach a decision, the action is handed to you for confirmation instead of failing immediately. Auto-naming now distinguishes between missing message content and an unsupported provider instead of showing the same generic error.

topics.title: More accurate update status
topics.text: After an update package finishes downloading, the sidebar now says that the version is downloaded instead of implying it is already installed. Release notes and Restart to Update are easier to find, while active tasks are still checked before restarting.
